propositions: Attribute-form git wrapper calls (e.g. core._git, self._git, mod.run_git) are correctly detected by the existing ast.Attribute branch in _wrapper_name but lack test coverage, making the behavior appear absent
All 8 existing R2 tests in test_raw_git_write_lint.py exercise only bare-name form (ast.Name), leaving attribute-form receivers undocumented and vulnerable to accidental removal in future refactors

_ref_lock_push.py has no gate hits not because attribute calls escape, but because its single wrapper call passes 'push', which is not in MUTATION_VERBS, so the gate correctly declines to fire without needing a marker
The gate's module docstring must be updated to explicitly document that wrapper matching is by callable attribute name regardless of receiver shape, replacing implicit 'BY NAME' coverage
Four new tests must pin attribute-form behavior: mutation verb firing, receiver-shape independence, fail-closed opaque argv with marker sanctioning, and the push_lease_cas non-firing disposition
